question: Which of the following article of Indian constitution is related with “Separation of Judiciary from Executive"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 50.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 50** of the Indian Constitution states that the State shall take steps to** separate the judiciary from the executive** in the** public services** of the State.
 
• The purpose of **separating the judiciary from the executive **is to ensure the** independence of the judiciary**, which is crucial for the rule of law and protection of individual rights.
 
• This separation ensures that the **executive does not interfere **with the functioning of the judiciary and that the judiciary is** free to make impartial decisions** without any external influence.
 
• The separation of powers between the judiciary and the executive is a** fundamental principle of the Indian Constitution **and is necessary for the proper functioning of democracy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 40** of the Indian Constitution is related to the** organization of village panchayats.**
 
• **Article 44 **of the Indian Constitution states that the State shall endeavor to secure for the** citizens a uniform civil code **throughout the territory of India.
 
• **Article 46** of the Indian Constitution states that the State shall promote with** special care the educational and economic interests of the weaker sections **of the people and in particular, of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes.
